title: Release
description: One immutable published build, numbered in the order of publication, and the advisories it fixes. A ring's floor is a release sequence number.

hostUnits.description: The store path of the host units that the release installs.

images.description: The images of the release, as `application:tag`.

candidates.description: The fix candidates that the release contains.

fix.title: ReleaseFix
fix.description: One advisory that the release fixes.

kevDateAdded.description: The date on which CISA added the vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
